rca of the issue: RCA: runtime logs consistently show React/DOM structure warnings during Add Emission rendering: (1) invalid span nesting inside select/option nodes, (2) missing key prop in Step3 list rendering, and (3) missing dialog description linkage. Repro steps: login as admin -> open /ghg/scope1 -> click Add Emission -> select facility/category/fuel -> open month accordion / switch scope. Mitigation: fix JSX/render tree for select options, ensure stable key props in mapped month content, and add proper Dialog description/aria-describedby wiring.
